credit.title: Credit
credit.description: Get cash against your escrowed orders. Loans are provided by our NBFC partner.
credit.lenderNote: The lender of record is {lender}. cnote does not lend its own money: we share your credit score with the lender only after you agree, and the lender makes every credit decision.
credit.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.heading: Your consent
consent.off: To check your credit score and offer financing, we need your permission to use your GST verification, escrow order history, dispute record and trust score. Nothing is shared with the lender until you apply, and only a score with a few summary figures is shared, never your GST returns.
consent.on: You have allowed cnote to use your GST verification, escrow history, dispute record and trust score to compute your credit score and to share a summary with the lender when you apply.
consent.withdrawNote: Withdrawing stops new scores and any further sharing with the lender. Applications that are not yet accepted are cancelled. Existing loans continue as agreed with the lender.

score.heading: Your platform credit score
score.none: Your score will appear here once it has been computed.
score.explain: The score is between 300 and 900 and is computed by fixed rules from your verified GST status and filings, escrow orders, disputes and trust score. It is refreshed when any of these change and every night.

reasons.GST_VERIFICATION_STALE: GST verification is old; it is re-checked regularly
reasons.GST_FILINGS_MISSED: Some recent GST returns were not filed
reasons.ESCROW_LOW_VOLUME: Low total value of completed escrow orders
reasons.ESCROW_REFUNDS: Escrow orders that ended in refunds

eligible.heading: Orders you can finance
eligible.intro: Invoice financing gives you an advance on an order the buyer has already paid into escrow. When escrow releases the money, the lender is repaid first and you receive the rest.
eligible.none: No funded escrow orders are available for financing right now.
eligible.blocked: You cannot use invoice financing yet: {reasons}

blockers.gst_inactive: your GST registration is not active
blockers.score_too_low: your score is below the lender's minimum
blockers.escrow_frozen: a dispute is open on the order
blockers.escrow_not_funded: the buyer has not funded escrow
blockers.amount_too_small: the possible advance is below the minimum

applications.heading: Applications
applications.empty: You have not applied for financing yet.

kfs.heading: Key Fact Statement
kfs.intro: Read this before you accept. It is provided by the lender, {lender}.
kfs.allInApr: Total cost of credit including fees (per year)
kfs.lateFeeValue: {percent} per month on the overdue amount
kfs.coolingOffValue: {days} days after disbursal. You can exit by repaying the principal plus interest for the days you used, with no penalty. The exact amount is shown before you confirm.
kfs.repayment_escrow_release: Automatically from the escrow payout for this order, before the balance reaches you. If it does not cover the total, you pay the rest to the lender directly.
kfs.repayment_buyer_instalment: By you, to the lender, by the due date.
kfs.cnoteRole: cnote is not the lender. It shares your score and summary figures with the lender and shows you the lender's offer.

accept.acknowledge: I have read the Key Fact Statement and agree to take this loan from {lender}.
accept.noAuto: Nothing is charged until you accept.

loans.heading: Loans
loans.exitOwed: Owed to the lender on exit
loans.cancelledExit: You exited this loan within the cooling-off period. Repay the amount owed directly to the lender. No penalty applies.

exit.heading: Exit this loan (cooling-off period)
exit.intro: You can cancel this loan without any penalty until {date}. You repay the principal and interest for the days you used. Nothing else is charged.
exit.total: You repay the lender to exit
exit.note_invoice_financing: After you exit, the escrow payout for this order comes to you in full, and you pay the amount above to the lender directly.
exit.note_bnpl: After you exit, you repay the amount above to the lender directly. The escrow payment already made stays with the order.
exit.confirm: I want to exit this loan and repay the amount above to {lender}.
